meta.case: Pipeline, Oahu: typical winter swell, illustrative, not a forecast
meta.label: illustrative, not a forecast
meta.swell_source: NOAA NDBC 51201 Waimea Bay buoy (public domain), historical stdmet 2024 + 2025, months Nov-Mar, records with MWD 280-350 deg and DPD >= 12 s (n = 8,321): median WVHT 2.11 m, DPD 14.29 s, MWD 320 deg (p75 WVHT 2.62 m). All winter records: median WVHT 2.01 m, DPD 13.3 s. Files pieces/05-pipeline/data/raw/ndbc_51201/51201h2024.txt.gz, 51201h2025.txt.gz
meta.tide_note: 0.0 m = LMSL (the datum of the lidar); Haleiwa spring range is only ~0.6 m
meta.viewer_note: Typical winter swell from NOAA NDBC 51201 Waimea Bay buoy (public domain);  Illustrative, not a forecast.
meta.order: same order and count as pipeline.json

takeoff.how: published spot position (Wikipedia, Banzai Pipeline), approximate

fields.broken: 1 = broken (height held at gamma x depth)
fields.state: 0 dry or in the lee of dry land, 1 unbroken, 2 broken, 3 not reachable

assumptions: linear waves, one height and one period for the whole sea
offshore height treated as deep-water height; no losses before the lidar edge
refraction by Snell's law for straight contours parallel to the local (100 m smoothed) shore
nothing outside the lidar box (no headland sheltering, no offshore canyon focusing)
breaking when H >= gamma x depth; held at gamma x depth inside the surf zone
it does not simulate the shape of a breaking wave
